svg.title: DnBOX source control map: C3 to C6, central F3 to G5, and mode-specific pads
svg.desc: Research diagram, not approved product artwork or observed device evidence. Physical key index 5 F3 is W1; index 6 F sharp 3 is B1. First physical black C sharp 3 is outside the control region. Grid pad origin is top source pad zero; ordinary note origin is bottom pad eight. Physical pad left-right orientation is unverified.
svg.text: SOURCE RESEARCH • proposed teaching aid • S25/S26 scoped mappings agree • device interaction NOT_RUN
k = zero-based physical index; W/B = one-based logical colour numbering within F3–G5. Note names use source convention.
B1 = F#3 (k6): 909 BD in the appropriate drum view. C#3 (k1) is outside this numbering.
Four quarter-note steps: W1/F3 • W5/C4 • W9/G4 • W13/D5 (blue white keys).
HOME B3 = A#3 (k10): BREAK part mute. Drum views use a different HOME modifier rule.
These are untransposed key labels. Octave, current view and input ownership can change the musical role.
16 pads: three HAL layouts; origin depends on mode
Top hardware p0–p7; bottom p8–p15. Columns below are source order 0–7; physical left/right is UNVERIFIED.
Scope: HAL note mappings, not every musical pad role. Free Play division ownership may consume pads before notes.
Do not teach this as a fixed universal pad map; verify the current mode and approved firmware interaction contract.
SAVE: under default panel mapping, unused BT press-release requests save. Hold can enter paste targeting.
STOP ≠ SAVED. REC, held/queued notes, clip activity, storage guards and write failures can still prevent saving.
Full citations, calibration caveat and higher-level exceptions: controls-save-research.md. No source or device change.
